personality_one_liner: A structured, accessible, and welcoming utility interface designed for clarity and confidence, accommodating low-literacy users through large targets, clear colors, and multi-modal support.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Use on bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Use on sticky headers over scrolling content
dont's: Never blur form fields, body text regions, or entire screens
Avoid on dense list rows to maintain high contrast for low-literacy users

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Simple email and password login entry point.
screens.layout: Minimalist single-column form centered vertically. Large input fields with labels above. Sticky full-width submit button pinned to the bottom (above keyboard).

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Role-aware dashboard showing 'What needs you now' via large, colorful task tiles.
screens.layout: Header with role switcher and fixed Voice Guidance speaker button. Content is a 2-column grid of oversized touch target tiles (`surfaceSecondary` or `brandSecondary`) with large count badges and paired icons/text. Flat, scrollable self-contained page.

screens.name: ListingsOrJobs
screens.purpose: Manage property/item listings or Fixa job requests depending on role.

states.empty: Friendly abstract illustration + 'No listings yet' + Primary 'Add' CTA

screens.layout: List view with large thumbnails and simple status badges (color + icon, e.g., Green check for active). Includes a Job Status Stepper (On my way -> Working -> Finished) for Fixa providers. FAB at bottom right to trigger creation wizard.

screens.name: Messages
screens.purpose: Inbox for enquiries, leads chat, and activity notifications.

states.empty: Minimal empty mailbox illustration + 'No messages yet'

screens.layout: Standard list view with large avatars (initials or real PNGs). Minimum 56pt row height for easy tapping.

screens.name: Me
screens.purpose: Profile settings, language picker, voice toggle, and role management.
screens.layout: Single-column list of oversized setting rows. Icon + Label structure. Language picker clearly visible.

home_hero_bg.alt: Warm red abstract texture for hero section

empty_state_tasks.alt: Abstract neon sign reading empty for no tasks

empty_state_messages.alt: Minimal pink background with a red mailbox

instructions_to_main_agent: ACCESSIBILITY FIRST: Target users may have low literacy. Ensure ALL touch targets are at least 56x56pt (oversized from standard 44pt) using hitSlop or padding.
MULTI-MODAL: Place a prominent 'Speaker' (Voice Guidance) icon button in the header of EVERY screen using expo-speech.
NO STANDALONE ICONS: Every icon must be paired with a simple, clear text label. Icons alone are often misinterpreted by this demographic.
COLOR + ICON STATUS: Statuses must be understandable without reading. Use semantic colors paired with distinct icons (e.g., success Green + Checkmark, warning Gold + Clock).
FLAT NAVIGATION: Avoid deep hierarchies or complex nested menus. Rely heavily on the bottom tab bar (max 4 tabs: Home, Listings/Jobs, Messages, Me).
CREATE WIZARD: Use a step-by-step wizard pattern for creating listings with photos, showing one clear action per screen to reduce cognitive load.

RESEARCH LEARNING: Low literacy users struggle with scrolling and dense text. Keep screens self-contained where possible, use auto-complete/varied input for forms, and prioritize large visual tiles for navigation.
BRANDING: Strictly adhere to the provided Amass color palette and typography (DM Serif Display for headings/prices, Plus Jakarta Sans for body). Do NOT introduce unauthorized blues or purples.
